name: Gradaly v4.1.0
title: Gradaly v4.1.0
notes:
### New Features & Improvements
- **On-Demand Copy Integrity Audit & Thumbnail Strip (Copies Tab)**: Added an on-demand verification tool to detect missing pages, extra pages, swapped pages, upside-down (180°) pages, landscape pages, and optional blank pages before grading, complete with anomaly filtering and one-click PDF repair.
- **High-Precision Multi-Scale RANSAC + Web Worker Pool**: Uses 2x2 supersampled template corner anchors, soft-clamped ink normalization for thin LaTeX box templates, cycle-based swap validation (including swaps with blank/draft pages), and multi-scale similarity RANSAC across a parallel Web Worker pool for fast, zero-false-positive detection.
